title: campanula rotundifolia f. ovata
intro: Campanula rotundifolia f. ovata, commonly known as a form of the Scottish heather, is a flowering plant that belongs to the bellflower family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to soothe respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Campanula rotundifolia f. ovata include expectorant and antiseptic properties, which may aid in relieving coughs and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
